title: finding(examples): `console-starter`'s `loadLanguage` returns the app translation payload untransformed, so every spec bundle it loads lands at the i18next root where nothing reads it
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it. The site is `examples/console-starter/src/main.tsx` (`loadLanguage`).

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10235 (PR objectui#10344). The dev measured it; ⛔ it is filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

The console's loader (`apps/console/src/loadLanguage.ts`) branches on `isSpecTranslationData`. It sends a spec `TranslationData` through `transformSpecTranslations`, which namespaces the payload under `app`, where `useObjectLabel` and the flow runner read it. The **starter** example's `loadLanguage` returns `json?.data?.translations` **with no transform at all**. Every spec bundle the starter's README says it loads therefore lands at the root of the i18next resource tree, where nothing reads it. An author who starts from the example sees their authored labels in every locale, with no error.

## Reproduction (the dev's probe: the built `@object-ui/i18n` dist plus `react-dom/server`, not committed)

- The payload `{objects:{crm_lead:{label:'线索', fields:{name:{label:'名称'}}}}}` (it even carries a field label) run through the starter's loader logic renders `Lead`.
- The control, the same payload through `transformSpecTranslations` as the console does it, renders `线索`.
- ⚠️ These readings are the dev's, relayed by the seat, ⛔ not re-run by the seat.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- Same defect class as objectui#10235 (a spec bundle landing un-namespaced), on the copy-paste starting point a new author uses.
- The obvious fix is for the starter to use the console's branch (`isSpecTranslationData` ⇒ `transformSpecTranslations`), both of which are published by `@object-ui/i18n`.
- Routing: `examples/**` is routed by what it exercises.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items, pattern `console-starter … (loadLanguage|translation|transformSpecTranslations|i18n)` ⇒ 0 hits. Control pattern `isSpecTranslationData` ⇒ objectui#10235, the must-hit control, which did hit.

Dedupe words: `console-starter loadLanguage transformSpecTranslations` · `console-starter translations never namespaced` · `example loader spec payload at i18next root` · `starter useObjectLabel renders authored label`
